title: Simon 6.2.30 and 6.3.10 on parametrizations: the cone over a parametrized cycle is parametrized by z ↦ s(z)·F_j(τ(z)) on (0,1) × A_j
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ, S ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) and R ∈ 𝒟_{n+2}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ on ℝ^P = Euclid P), and for j ∈ ℕ let F_j : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P, A_j ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} and g_j : ℝ^{n+1} → ℤ. For a map H : ℝ^d → ℝ^P write DH(u) := fderiv ℝ H u, e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1, ∂H(u) := (DH(u)e_a)_{a<d} and JH(u) := (det[⟨DH(u)e_a, DH(u)e_b⟩]_{a,b})^{1/2}. Assume: (i) spt S is compact; (ii) each F_j is Lipschitz; (iii) each A_j is Borel; (iv) each g_j is measurable and (g_j : ℝ) is Lebesgue integrable on A_j; (v) F_j is differentiable at every point of A_j; (vi) F_j(A_j) ⊆ spt S; (vii) Σ_j ∫⁻_{A_j} |g_j|·JF_j < ∞; (viii) for every test (n+1)-form γ, HasSum (j ↦ ∫_{A_j} g_j(u)·γ(F_j u)(∂F_j(u)) du) (S(γ)); (ix) for every test (n+2)-form ω there is a test (n+1)-form γ with R(ω) = S(γ) and γ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^{n+1} ω(tx)(Fin.cons x v) dt for every x ∈ spt S and v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ^P. Then there are maps G_j : ℝ^{n+2} → ℝ^P, sets B_j ⊆ ℝ^{n+2} and functions w_j : ℝ^{n+2} → ℤ (j ∈ ℕ) such that each G_j is Lipschitz, each B_j is Borel, each w_j is measurable with (w_j : ℝ) integrable on B_j, Σ_j ∫⁻_{B_j} |w_j|·JG_j < ∞, and for every test (n+2)-form ω, HasSum (j ↦ ∫_{B_j} w_j(z)·ω(G_j z)(∂G_j(z)) dz) (R(ω)).
